tasks.objective: Produce an evidenced decision record for pagination, complete-list web behavior and external migration prerequisites before dependent implementation begins.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional 60-minute local synthesis of inspected contracts and consumers, excluding unknown external response time. Pagination semantics and migration policy remain undecided; no comparable execution history is available.
acceptance_criteria: Record D1's limit bounds, tuple ordering, cursor format, terminal behavior and validation rules with genuine decision evidence.
Record D2's complete-list web behavior and live-consistency limitations with genuine decision evidence.
Record D3's transition policy, browser cutover requirements and required external notice evidence without asserting unknown MCP compatibility.
Keep T1 incomplete and dependent tasks gated if any material decision remains unresolved; revise the draft if a transition endpoint or snapshot guarantee is required.

tasks.title: Define summary and page schemas
tasks.objective: Provide shared runtime schemas and inferred types for five-field project summaries and required nullable continuation cursors.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional 45-minute additive schema and focused test change using the existing contracts package. Conditional on T1; no measured comparable history is available.
acceptance_criteria: Export ProjectListItemSchema and ProjectListPageSchema with inferred types through the existing project exports.
Summary items contain exactly id, externalKey, name, revision and updatedAt; page responses require projects and nextCursor as string or null.
New schema tests accept valid empty and populated pages and reject missing nextCursor and snapshot-only fields.
ProjectImportSchema, ProjectSnapshotSchema and generated import-schema artifacts retain their existing contracts.

verification.purpose: Exercise the new summary/page schema cases alongside existing import validation.
Check the shared schema exports and inferred types.

verification.value: Review the contract diff and import-schema generation scope.
verification.purpose: Confirm the additive list contract does not alter the existing import protocol.
verification.expected: Import and snapshot definitions retain existing behavior, and generated import artifacts are unchanged.

complexity.justification: Existing strict Zod snapshot fields provide a direct basis for additive list schemas.

scope.justification: Only the shared project schema module and its existing test file need changes.

duration.justification: Existing schema tests and package scripts support a short additive implementation and verification pass.

risk.justification: Shared schema mistakes propagate into both API serialization and web response handling.

coupling.justification: The project-list-contract types are consumed by repository, HTTP and web tasks.

confidence.justification: Schema conventions are inspected while final pagination policy still depends on T1.

tasks.title: Implement repository keyset listing
tasks.objective: Replace full snapshot listing with a metadata-only keyset query that returns bounded items and an optional continuation boundary.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional 100-minute repository change plus SQLite boundary fixtures and regressions. Existing repository tests provide setup patterns, but pagination has no existing coverage or comparable timing history.
acceptance_criteria: Accept a validated limit and optional updatedAt/id boundary; project only id, external_key, name, revision and updated_at.
Order by updated_at DESC and id DESC; continue with updated_at less than the boundary timestamp, or equal timestamp and id less than the boundary id.
Fetch at most limit plus one rows, return at most limit items, and derive continuation from the last returned row only when lookahead exists.
Tests prove empty and exact-size terminal pages, full traversal without duplicates or omissions on unchanged data, tied timestamps and continuation after boundary-row deletion.
Listing does not parse data_json or call the snapshot mapper; a fixture with JSON-valid but schema-invalid project data remains listable.
Detail, mutation, revision-conflict behavior and database schema remain unchanged.

verification.purpose: Exercise new keyset boundary cases and existing repository revision behavior after the contracts build prerequisite.

verification.value: Inspect the list SQL, parameters and row mapping.
verification.purpose: Verify bounded metadata projection rather than merely filtering full snapshots after retrieval.
verification.expected: The list query selects only five metadata columns, binds boundary values and limit, and never invokes snapshot parsing.

complexity.justification: Repository pagination requires tuple predicates, deterministic ties and correct lookahead boundaries.

scope.justification: The repository list method and existing SQLite tests contain the bounded change.

duration.justification: Repository fixtures exist but empty, tied and multi-page cases must be added.

risk.justification: Incorrect cursor boundaries can omit projects while still returning successful list responses.

coupling.justification: The project-list-query result is the direct input to T4 HTTP pagination.

confidence.justification: SQLite columns and repository behavior are inspected, but new traversal cases remain unexecuted.

tasks.title: Expose and validate the paginated endpoint
tasks.objective: Serve the selected page contract through the authenticated list route with bounded cursor parsing and predictable HTTP errors.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional 100-minute route/parser implementation with a new HTTP test harness using existing Node facilities. Public contract sensitivity and absent route tests increase uncertainty; no comparable history is available.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve authentication before query validation and return exactly projects and nextCursor for successful list requests.
Apply the T1-selected proposal of default 50 and maximum 100; reject supplied noncanonical, empty, repeated or out-of-range limits while ignoring unrelated query keys.

Decode only bounded canonical base64url JSON cursors with version 1, canonical UTC ISO updatedAt and nonempty id of at most 100 characters; reject supplied empty, repeated, oversized, malformed or unsupported cursors.
Convert invalid query and cursor input to HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR using the existing error envelope instead of leaking decoding exceptions as HTTP 500.
Emit a cursor from the repository continuation boundary or null at exhaustion, including an empty result.

HTTP tests cover cookie and bearer access, unauthorized requests, metadata-only responses, default and boundary limits, traversal and invalid inputs; detail responses still contain full snapshot data.

verification.purpose: Exercise real HTTP routing, authentication, query validation and SQLite pagination after building contracts.
Check route, parser and repository interface compatibility.

complexity.justification: The route must reconcile Express query values, cursor decoding and existing Zod error handling.

scope.justification: One list route gains a focused parser and HTTP tests without changing other endpoint contracts.

duration.justification: The API test command supports new test files but no route harness currently exists.

risk.justification: This public endpoint serves browser and bearer consumers whose compatibility depends on its response.

coupling.justification: The project-list-contract route consumes T3 boundaries and supplies T5 web traversal.

confidence.justification: Authentication and error conventions are inspected; new HTTP fixtures and cursor validation remain untested.

tasks.title: Adapt complete-list loading and tab reconciliation
tasks.objective: Preserve both screens' complete project collections while preventing partial, stale or live-pagination omissions from erasing valid tabs.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional 180-minute client and refresh-state change including first focused web tests and runner setup. Two inspected consumers share complete-list assumptions; asynchronous races increase uncertainty. No comparable execution history is available.
acceptance_criteria: Use shared summary/page types while retaining listProjects() as a complete-list helper returning a projects collection to both existing callers.
Establish the session once per load and fetch pages sequentially with encoded cursors until nextCursor is null; never publish an intermediate page.
Reject later-page errors, invalid page envelopes and repeated continuation tokens; preserve the previously completed collection and saved tabs on failure.
Deduplicate by id, retain the highest revision with first-seen preference on equal revisions, and order the completed collection by updatedAt DESC and id DESC.
Ignore superseded refresh completions; before pruning missing saved or active tabs, fetch their details and remove only on confirmed 404, retaining tabs on other errors.

Add focused Node/tsx tests for traversal, late failure, duplicates, repeated cursors, refresh ordering and confirmed-deletion rules; declare the web runner dependency and update its test script and lockfile.
Preserve existing navigation, picker, creation and deletion interactions without introducing pagination controls.

verification.purpose: Exercise the new complete-load and tab-state tests through the T5-configured Node/tsx runner.
Check shared list types and both React consumers.

verification.value: Inspect both screen refresh paths and saved-tab reconciliation after the client change.
verification.purpose: Confirm incomplete or superseded loads cannot trigger destructive tab persistence.
verification.expected: Only current completed loads update list state; absent saved tabs require a detail 404 before removal.

complexity.justification: Complete traversal interacts with overlapping refreshes, live ordering and persisted tab deletion.

scope.justification: Changes remain within the shared web loader, its two consumers and focused test configuration.

duration.justification: The web lacks focused tests, so traversal and reconciliation require runner setup and new fixtures.

risk.justification: Treating a partial collection as complete can remove valid persisted tabs and hide projects.

coupling.justification: The web-project-refresh behavior consumes T4 pagination and supplies T6 screen verification.

confidence.justification: Both consumers and session handling are inspected, but asynchronous scenarios need new executable coverage.

Verify IF-1 through IF-3 against the implemented schemas, repository query, HTTP responses and web loader.
Using at least 101 projects and tied timestamps, verify the project list, picker, saved tab and direct-link navigation for projects beyond page one.
Verify detail editing, create/delete refresh, empty data, later-page failure and superseded refresh behavior against the real web/API.
Document live-traversal limitations and distinguish automated assertions from manual product evidence; do not infer external MCP compatibility.

verification.purpose: Verify the real HTTP page contract reaches both screen consumers without partial-state publication.

interfaces.title: Shared project summary and page schemas
inputs: T1-selected five-field list-item and page-envelope contract
outputs: ProjectListPageSchema and inferred page type with required nextCursor
invariants: Summary items contain only id, externalKey, name, revision and updatedAt.
nextCursor is a string or null and is never omitted.
Existing import and full snapshot contracts retain their behavior.
integration_criteria: Repository results and actual HTTP pages satisfy the shared shape.
Web consumers use the same summary definition and do not require snapshot fields for listing.

interfaces.title: Repository keyset page boundary
outputs: At most limit project summaries in descending updatedAt/id order
Optional next boundary derived from the last returned item when lookahead exists
invariants: The continuation predicate is exclusive and uses the same tuple ordering as the query.
The query selects only summary metadata and fetches at most limit plus one rows.
Continuation does not require the boundary row to remain present.
An unchanged dataset is traversed without duplicates or omissions; live mutation does not provide snapshot consistency.
integration_criteria: HTTP traversal across tied timestamps returns every unchanged-dataset project exactly once.
Empty and exact-size terminal results expose nextCursor null.
Deletion of the previous boundary row does not invalidate continuation.

interfaces.title: Authenticated HTTP page consumed by the web
inputs: Existing browser cookie or MCP bearer authentication
Optional validated limit and opaque cursor query values
outputs: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination input
invariants: Successful list responses contain no full snapshot payload.
The web follows cursors until null and publishes only a completed collection.
Partial failures do not replace previous complete state, and missing tabs require detail-confirmed deletion.
integration_criteria: The actual browser list and picker expose projects beyond the first page.
Later-page failures and superseded refreshes preserve valid saved tabs.
Detail editing remains functional through unchanged snapshot endpoints.
